description: Agent Tax Records: submit a withholding record with the payroll runs and remittances it answers to: the payroll record with its reference, its currency and each payroll run with its id, reference, withholding period, the day wages were paid, the gross wages, the tax withheld from pay and any employer share owed with it; each withholding remittance with its id, reference, the withholding period it remits, the day remitted, the due date and the amount. The signed report gives the payroll record and the remittances, the tax withheld in each period against the remittances for that period, the remittances for each period recomputed from the withheld amounts and employer share in the payroll record, and each period that paid wages read for withholding, and counts them, and names a divergent withholding record: tax withheld from pay with no remittance for its period, remittances that do not recompute from the payroll record, and a withholding period skipped, with wages paid and nothing withheld while other periods withhold; then a remittance dated after its due date and a remittance for a period with no payroll run, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No payroll runs, no remittances, a run with no withheld figure, or a remittance with no amount leaves those points unverified. Runs and remittances group by period, read without case, punctuation or word order with quarters and month names folded, amounts compare to the cent and dates by the day. This reads the withholding against its remittance: wever_bookkeeping-payroll-check reads a payroll register against its ledger postings, while the withholding check reads the tax withheld from pay against the remittances that answer to it. Verdict tax_withholding_divergent, tax_withholding_partial, tax_withholding_unverified or tax_withholding_consistent. POST /api/tax-withholding-check. Reads the tax records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it gives no tax advice, prepares or files nothing and decides nothing about anyone’s tax liability, which stay with the taxpayer and their tax professional, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Tax Records reads tax records: a filed return, tax payment records, sales tax records, withholding records, information returns, estimated payment records, deduction claims and tax authority notices, each against the books, schedules and deadline, the amounts the filed returns state as due, the stated rate and the sales tax remittances, the payroll record and the withholding remittances, the payment records, the periods and amounts the stated method sets, the support records, or the filed returns and responses it answers to. The family’s ground is the tax record set itself; the Agent Bookkeeping family reads the books the filings are drawn from, and this family reads the filings, payments and notices after they exist. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-tax-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-tax-records/.
